hero.heading: Seasonal cooking over live fire
hero.subheading: A neighbourhood bistro serving wood-fired plates, natural wines and long dinners with friends.

about.heading: Our story
about.body:
Ember & Oak started in 2019 with a second-hand oven and a simple idea: cook what's in season, cook it over fire, and make people feel at home.

Today we work with a handful of local farms and fishermen, bake our own sourdough every morning and change the menu whenever the market does.

menuDisplay.note: Please tell your server about any allergies. A discretionary 12.5% service charge is added to tables of 6 or more.

posts.excerpt: Five courses celebrating the autumn harvest, paired with natural wines.
posts.body:
Join us for a long-table harvest supper with our friends from Greenfield Produce. Five courses, wine pairing optional.

Tickets are limited to 40 seats.

posts.excerpt: Squash, wild mushrooms and quince make their way onto the menu.
posts.body: Autumn is our favourite season to cook. This year's menu brings back the squash risotto, a new wild mushroom pizza and burnt basque cheesecake with poached quince.
